task1_frozen_pose_divergence.interpretation: First crossing is resolved only to the saved 2 ms sampling. Frozen comparisons use the same 128-source physical pose, qvel and external wrench with a fresh zero-warm-start forward solve. They isolate geometry/contact response sensitivity; neither resolution is established as physical truth.
task1_frozen_pose_divergence.wrench_convention: All components use world axes. M is the male body origin/COM; G = M + R*[0,0,-0.0145] m. tau_G = tau_M + (M-G) cross F. Free-joint angular qvel is body-local.

candidate_review.decision_scope: 256 / 0.0002 s MPR is a reasonable first bounded B1 development candidate because all seven stored 256 runs pass the old 0.2 s linear stop check. This does not establish resolution convergence, calibrated contact forces, full-domain reliability, or physical truth. Half-A/B sensitivity remains explicit.
